name: Ұлытау аллеясы
description_ru: Аллея площадью около 1,2 га между Триумфальной аркой на проспекте Мәңгілік Ел и улицей Түркістан — подарок Карагандинской области к 20-летию Астаны (2018). Здесь размещены копии памятников Улытау: балбалы, петроглифы, камень Тимура.
description_en: A 1.2-hectare alley between the Triumphal Arch on Mangilik El Avenue and Turkistan Street, given by Karaganda Region for Astana's 20th anniversary in 2018, with replicas of Ulytau heritage: stone balbals, petroglyphs and the Timur stone.
notes: Source is a news article from June 2018 announcing the gift (presentation planned 2 July 2018); the exhibit list describes what was planned. Location (between the arch and Turkistan St) is consistent with the coordinates. Current state not verified.

name: Astana Musical
description_ru: Центральный концертный зал «Qazaqstan» — здание в форме лепестков цветка по проекту Манфреди Николетти, открытое в 2009 году; главный зал вмещает 3500 зрителей. Здесь работают «Қазақконцерт» и государственный театр Astana Musical.
description_en: The Qazaqstan Central Concert Hall, a petal-shaped building by Manfredi Nicoletti opened in 2009, with a 3,500-seat main hall. It is home to the Qazaqconcert organisation and the state Astana Musical theatre.
notes: OSM name 'Astana Musical' refers to the theatre company based in the Central Concert Hall; Qazaqconcert site states the organisation operates in the QAZAQSTAN hall and lists ASTANA MUSICAL among its collectives. Box-office hours not found on official site; tickets sold via ticketon.

name: Beatles Statue
description_ru: Скульптурная композиция, изображающая участников группы The Beatles, на пешеходном Арбате в районе Сарыарка; появилась летом 2018 года.
description_en: A sculpture group depicting the members of The Beatles on Astana's pedestrian Arbat in Saryarka district, installed in summer 2018.
notes: Only source is a July 2018 news item (no sculptor, no exact spot). Match to the OSM node is inferred from the Arbat location on the right-bank embankment; current presence not verified. Not to be confused with the Beatles monument at Kok-Tobe in Almaty.

name: Олимпиада сақиналары
notes: No allowed source found. Coordinates are next to the Beeline Arena national tennis centre (Central Park area); nothing verifiable about the installation.

name: Ғашықтар саябағы
description_ru: Парк площадью около 14 га на левом берегу, между площадью Дөңгелек и ТРЦ «Хан Шатыр», открыт в 2005 году. Центр парка — большой фонтан, подаренный в 2007 году Габриэлой фон Габсбург.
description_en: A park of about 14 hectares on the left bank between Dongelek Square and Khan Shatyr, opened in 2005. Its centrepiece is a large fountain donated in 2007 by Gabriela von Habsburg.
notes: Also known as Youth Park (Жастар саябағы). Hours/24h access only found on non-allowed aggregator, so left null.

name: Chaplin Cinemas
description_ru: Кинотеатр сети Chaplin на втором этаже ТРЦ «Хан Шатыр»: шесть залов, включая VIP-зал на 24 места, со звуком Dolby Atmos и проекцией 4K и RealD 3D.
description_en: A six-screen Chaplin cinema on the second floor of the Khan Shatyr mall, including a 24-seat VIP hall, with Dolby Atmos sound and 4K/RealD 3D projection.
price_note: билеты от ~1700 ₸ (зависит от фильма и сеанса); 3D-очки 300 ₸
notes: Address per ticketon: Turan Ave 37, Khan Shatyr, 2nd floor. Official chaplin.kz pages render only via JS and could not be read.

name: Водно-Зеленый Бульвар
description_ru: Пешеходный бульвар Нуржол длиной около 2,2 км в административном центре левого берега, от Ак Орды до «Хан Шатыра»; спроектирован Кисё Курокавой. Вдоль него стоят Байтерек и здания правительства и парламента.
description_en: Nurzhol, a 2.2 km pedestrian boulevard in the left-bank administrative centre running from Ak Orda to Khan Shatyr, designed by Kisho Kurokawa and lined by Baiterek and government and parliament buildings.
notes: Водно-зелёный бульвар is the former name of Nurzhol Boulevard (per ru.wikipedia).

name: Қазақстан Республикасының Ұлттық академиялық кітапханасы
description_ru: Национальная академическая библиотека, открытая в 2004 году в пятиэтажном здании на левом берегу рядом с Байтереком. В фонде более 1,3 млн документов, в том числе коллекция арабских рукописей.
description_en: The National Academic Library, opened in 2004 in a five-storey building on the left bank near Baiterek. Its holdings exceed 1.3 million items, including a collection of Arabic manuscripts.
hours_note: летом в будни до 18:00; последняя пятница месяца — санитарный день; читателям с 16 лет
notes: Hours come from ru.wikipedia (article flagged as lacking sources); official nabrk.kz returned 403 and visitastana.kz was unreachable (its listing reportedly says 09:00-20:00 daily) — hours should be re-checked. Address per Wikipedia: Dostyk St 11. Collection-size figures in the article are inconsistent (infobox says 600,000).

description_en: An outlet of the Lepim i Varim dumpling chain, where dumplings are made by hand every day in an open kitchen.
notes: Description is chain-level from the official site, which lists an Astana menu but no addresses; the MEGA Silk Way branch itself was not verified with an allowed source.

name: Beeline Arena
description_ru: Национальный теннисный центр Beeline Arena в Астане; в 2026 году ITF присвоила ему «золотой статус» как центру подготовки теннисистов.
description_en: Beeline Arena is Astana's National Tennis Centre; in 2026 the ITF awarded it 'gold status' as a player-development centre.
notes: Source is a news item dated 27 Feb 2026 naming 'НТЦ Beeline Arena в Астане'. Its location in Central Park (consistent with the coordinates) comes only from non-allowed city guides; no official site found for hours or court rental prices.

name: Музей Искусств
description_ru: Городской музей искусств, открытый осенью 2025 года в здании школы конца XIX века (памятник истории и культуры с 1982 года). В экспозиции более 1600 казахских национальных музыкальных инструментов и коллекция народной одежды.
description_en: A city art museum opened in autumn 2025 in a late-19th-century former school building, a listed monument since 1982. It displays over 1,600 Kazakh national musical instruments and a collection of traditional clothing.
notes: Identification is inferred: news sources (akimat press releases via 24.kz, Dec 2025 and May 2026) describe the new city 'Музей Искусств' but give no street address, so the link to Otyrar 1/2 is not confirmed. A visitastana.kz listing (unreachable, seen only in search snippets) at Otyrar 1/2 describes paintings and sculpture instead — possible conflict. Existing CityPass hours (Tu-Su 09:00-18:00) could not be re-verified.
